summary.headline: D.P. Abhushan Q2 FY27 total income INR 761 crore, EBITDA INR 61 crore, PAT ~INR 40 crore; H1 PAT up 19% to INR 104 crore on festive shift.
summary.overview: Management attributed the weak Q2 to festive and wedding demand moving from September into Q3, with Navratri falling in October this year versus late September last year. Festive-to-wedding-season sales of INR 815 crore over 11 Oct to 8 Nov 2026 were up ~13.8% YoY, and management said the deferred demand is converting. H1 FY27 showed total income up 7% to ~INR 1,615 crore, EBITDA up 18% to ~INR 155 crore with margin of 9.61%, and PAT up 19% to ~INR 104 crore. The company also announced a preferential issue of equity and fully convertible warrants aggregating ~INR 558 crore, with ~INR 513 crore for retail expansion and inventory, and opened its first FOCO showroom at Jabalpur, taking the network to 14 stores.

financial_highlights.metric: Festive sales 11 Oct to 8 Nov 2026 (29 days)

segments.name: Gold jewellery
segments.commentary: Festive-period gold sales rose ~9.3% to INR 724 crore; H1 gold sales value up ~8% YoY. Gold is ~90% of inventory.

segments.name: Diamond jewellery
segments.commentary: Festive diamond sales ~INR 38 crore vs ~INR 14 crore last year; management admitted diamonds still lag and are being worked on. Studded is ~5-6% of inventory.

segments.name: Silver
segments.commentary: Festive silver sales up ~29% to ~INR 51 crore; H1 silver value up ~68% YoY. Silver and gift articles form the balance of inventory.

guidance_outlook: Management expects H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1; H1 has historically been 28-35% of annual revenue.
Expects 3 to 4 additional showrooms by March 2027, subject to execution timelines.
Jodhpur COCO (~5,200 sq ft) expected to open by December 2026; Mandsaur (~3,500 sq ft) and Sagar (~5,800 sq ft) expected operational by end FY27.
New stores expected to break even within 6-9 months; Jodhpur inventory INR 60-70 crore and capex INR 3.5-4 crore.
Expects Q3 and Q4 to look promising given large December-January wedding calendar; expects nine-month growth broadly in line with peers.
Will consider paying dividend; currently focus is on growth investment.
capex_capacity: Store count now 14: 13 COCO and 1 FOCO (Jabalpur, inaugurated 30 Oct 2026, ~3,750 sq ft; franchisee funds capex and inventory).
Dhar (MP, ~3,000 sq ft) opened end-March 2026; Dahod (Gujarat, ~3,200 sq ft) opened September 2026.
Expansion focus: Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Chhattisgarh and Maharashtra; Central India remains core.
Preferential issue of equity and fully convertible warrants of ~INR 558 crore; ~INR 513 crore for retail network and inventory for new stores, remainder for general corporate purposes.
Gold Metal Loans: ~60-65% of total banking limits are fungible towards GML.
demand_pricing: Management says Q2 softness was timing: Navratri moved fully into October and wedding purchases concentrated after September.
H1 FY27 footfall of ~1.02 lakh walk-ins with ~81% footfall-to-conversion ratio.
Gold exchange contributes ~28-30% of business, expected to continue while gold prices stay volatile.
Weddings and festivals form ~75-80% of business.
Gold Swarn Plus instalment scheme contributed ~INR 50 crore in about 5 months.
Inventory gain embedded in profit estimated at ~18-20%; balance attributed to making charges, which are levied on prevailing gold price.
Q2 revenue reportedly down ~21% YoY per analyst question; management redirected to H1 growth of ~7% and did not dispute the figure.

qa_highlights.question: Economics of the Jabalpur FOCO model and how the company earns.
qa_highlights.answer: Franchisee funds inventory and capex; company shares a portion of revenue with the franchisee under category-specific arrangements across gold, diamond and silver. No quantified share given.

qa_highlights.question: Jodhpur COCO capex, inventory, revenue potential and payback.
qa_highlights.answer: Breakeven expected in 6-9 months; inventory INR 60-70 crore and capex INR 3.5-4 crore. No revenue or payback figure given.

qa_highlights.question: Pricing of the preferential issue versus market price and minority shareholder view.
qa_highlights.answer: Price follows SEBI formula based on ~90-day average; it is a preferential allotment to select investors, not an open offer.

qa_highlights.question: GML versus non-GML debt split.
qa_highlights.answer: Limits are fungible; about 60-65% of total banking limits can be used for GML, decided by comparing international and spot prices.

qa_highlights.question: Store-wise revenue and gold volume disclosure.
qa_highlights.answer: Not feasible to publish store-wise data as the network grows; management will look at more geographic-level disclosure.

qa_highlights.question: Gold price risk and inventory gain in P&L.
qa_highlights.answer: Inventory gain estimated at ~18-20% of profit; balance from making charges set on current gold price.

qa_highlights.question: Why peers reported double-digit growth while the company declined ~21% YoY in Q2.
qa_highlights.answer: Management pointed to H1 growth of ~7%, festive/wedding shift to Q3, and peer differences in geography and diamond mix; expects nine-month trajectory broadly in line with peers.

qa_highlights.question: Confidence in H2 FY27 growth and FY27 revenue ballpark.
qa_highlights.answer: Confident of anticipated growth; no numeric FY27 revenue guidance given.

risks_watch: Q2 revenue decline ~21% YoY (per analyst) and weak diamond sales; watch Q3 and nine-month numbers for timing-shift claims.
Dependence on gold exchange (28-30%) and GML borrowings; gold price volatility affects inventory gains (~18-20% of profit).
Execution risk on 3-4 new stores by March 2027, Jodhpur opening by December 2026, and deployment of ~INR 513 crore raised funds.
Preferential issue pricing well below recent trading range (INR 1,500-2,100 per share cited by a minority investor) raises dilution and minority-perception concerns.
Management declined store-wise disclosure; limited granularity going forward.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the festive-shift narrative and H2 outlook, but defensive on Q2 quarterly weakness and on peer comparison, repeatedly pointing to half-year figures. Evasive on pricing rationale for the preferential issue and on store-level disclosure, and noncommittal on dividends.
key_quotes: We do not want to expand simply for the sake of adding stores.
There is a dedicated formula prescribed by SEBI for calculating the price.

adds.what: 3 to 4 additional showrooms by March 2027 (Jodhpur, Mandsaur, Sagar pipeline)

growth.why: Management expects H2 stronger than H1 and 3-4 new showrooms by March 2027, with Jodhpur due December 2026 and an INR 558 crore fundraise (INR 513 crore for retail and inventory) backing the store push; festive sales were up 13.8% YoY over 29 days, though the call gives no explicit full-year revenue number.

rows.label: Margin expansion

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Jabalpur FOCO opened 30 Oct 2026, Jodhpur COCO (~5,200 sq ft) is due by December 2026, and 3-4 more showrooms are planned by March 2027 backed by a ~INR 558 crore raise (~INR 513 crore for retail and inventory); store count rises from 14 with execution risk noted.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management expects H2 stronger than H1 (H1 usually 28-35% of annual revenue); festive sales were up ~13.8% YoY to ~INR 815 crore over 29 days, and H1 total income grew only ~7%.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Capex is already in motion: an INR 558 crore preferential issue of equity and warrants is announced, Jodhpur capex is INR 3.5-4 crore with inventory of INR 60-70 crore, and Mandsaur and Sagar are planned by end-FY27; utilisation was not disclosed.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: No numeric FY27 revenue guidance was given, management is defensive on the ~21% Q2 YoY decline (per analyst) and pointed to H1 growth of ~7% instead.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Q2 revenue reportedly fell ~21% YoY and diamond sales lag; the H2 recovery depends on the wedding-season shift holding and on nine-month growth matching peers, which management has not quantified.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Diamond jewellery is being worked on after festive sales rose to ~INR 38 crore from ~INR 14 crore, but no launch date or product was specified.

rows.label: FOCO franchise model and store rollout in Central and West India
rows.why: Jabalpur FOCO opened 30 Oct 2026 with franchisee-funded capex and inventory, and expansion focus covers MP, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Chhattisgarh and Maharashtra, with Dhar and Dahod already opened in 2026.

rows.label: Store breakeven in 6-9 months
rows.why: Management expects new stores to break even within 6-9 months; Jodhpur carries INR 60-70 crore inventory and INR 3.5-4 crore capex, so working capital absorbs much of the fundraise.

rows.label: Gold Swarn Plus instalment scheme and GML funding
rows.why: Gold Swarn Plus added ~INR 50 crore in about 5 months and ~60-65% of banking limits are fungible to GML, but gold price volatility drives ~18-20% of profit via inventory gains.

tone.note: Management was confident on the festive-shift narrative, H2 outlook and store rollout, but defensive on the Q2 decline and peer comparison, and evasive on preferential issue pricing and store-level disclosure; analysts pushed on the ~21% Q2 YoY revenue fall, diamond weakness and dilution at a price

oneOffs.what: Festive and wedding demand shifted from September (Q2) into October-November (Q3) because Navratri fell in October this year; management says Q2 weakness is timing, not lost demand
Inventory gains estimated at ~18-20% of reported profit, embedded in PAT as gold prices rose

quality.why: H1 FY27 total income grew only ~7% and PAT ~19%, but Q2 revenue reportedly fell ~21% YoY (not disputed by management) because festive demand moved into Q3, so the half-year figure is flattered by timing that is yet to be confirmed; roughly 18-20% of profit is inventory gain from rising gold prices, which is a price effect rather than operating growth.
